reason: Deterministic CLI over a live management key: every assertion in evals/prompts.md was executed against the OpenRouter API on 2026-10-23 and checked against real output. No judged/subjective criterion is involved.

prompts.name: spend-last-7-days
prompts.prompt: How much did I spend on OpenRouter in the last 7 days, and on which models?

expectations.text: Report names an explicit period with both bounds
Request and prompt/completion/reasoning/total token totals printed
expectations.evidence: run: Requests 2,762; Prompt 259,549,292; Completion 1,783,339; Reasoning 910,324; Total 262,242,955

expectations.text: Cost line in USD from the API `usage` field

expectations.evidence: run: by-model section printed, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash first at $7.8920 over the 30-day window
run: `--credits` printed the credits summary with no activity table

expectations.text: No activity table printed in credits mode
expectations.evidence: run: mode returns before the activity path

prompts.name: single-day
prompts.prompt: Show me the OpenRouter activity for 2026-10-22.

expectations.text: Period line is a single day
Per-model and per-date sections carry that day only
expectations.evidence: run: one model row (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b) and one date row

expectations.text: Date rows formatted YYYY-MM-DD without a time suffix

prompts.name: today-refused
prompts.prompt: What have I spent on OpenRouter today?

expectations.evidence: run: `--date 2026-10-23` → exit 2, single warning line, no traceback

expectations.text: States the day is not completed and names the latest available day
expectations.evidence: run: `2026-10-23 is not a completed UTC day ... latest available is 2026-10-22.`

expectations.text: Answer labels the figures as the latest completed day, not today
expectations.evidence: manual: response template in SKILL.md § Reporting rules requires that labelling

prompts.name: json-output
prompts.prompt: Dump the last 3 days of OpenRouter usage as JSON to a file so I can process it.

expectations.text: Writes a JSON array and reports the record count
File parses and items carry date/model/token/requests/usage
expectations.evidence: run: file parsed with json.loads; fields date, model_permaslug, usage present per item

prompts.name: regular-key-403
prompts.prompt: (operator error) Query the activity with my normal inference key.

expectations.evidence: run: `❌ OpenRouter /activity returned 403: {"error":{"message":"Only management keys can fetch activity for an account","code":403}}`
run: exit 1, no report block printed

expectations.text: Answer points at creating a management key
expectations.evidence: manual: SKILL.md § Prerequisites names openrouter.ai/settings/keys and the exact 403 text
